headline: Fish Exchange general manager Robert resigns, staying until end of December; small group to update job posting.
summary: A small working group will update the job description before the job is posted. The December 14 retreat will focus on goal setting. Staff presented three auction software options: the current C-Track system, a C-BID proposal charging 5% of fees, and a Base system charging seven cents a pound. Staff is still gathering cost figures to compare them.
decisions: Tabled the oyster fee structure until more information is gathered.
discussion: General manager search: Members weighed posting the job now against waiting until after the December 14 retreat. Some raised the need for an interim plan for January 1, and an operations manager was named as a possible candidate.

Auction software replacement: Staff presented options, and cost comparisons are still being gathered. Some members favored a local company and grant funding over per-pound fees, and others said the current system is outdated and causes login delays.

Offload fee request: A fisherman who left the exchange asked for a 10-cent-a-pound fee instead of 20 cents for direct unloads. Members weighed lost buyer fees against losing the boat, and agreed to revisit the fee at a future meeting.
Oyster fee research: Staff is studying how other oyster auctions set fees. The item was tabled until that information is ready.

decision_evidence.quote: So we are going to wait to discuss this. We're going to table it for now until we get more information so we can be better prepared to make a decision.

decision_titles: Fee structure for oysters sold at auction
